d:
prastut karat ba "Bihari Ke Dum", Power Star Pawan Singh aa Srishti Bharti ke damdar aavaj men ego josh se bharal bhojpuri gana.
Neelam Giri ke shandar andaj aa damdar skrin prejens gana ke vidiyo men char chand laga dela.
Gana sunin, vidiyo ke maja lin aa "Bihari Ke Dum" ke apna bhojpuri myujik plelist men jarur shamil karin.
Audio Credits:
Song: Bihari Ke Dum
Singers: Pawan Singh, Srishti Bharti
Featuring: Pawan Singh, Neelam Giri
Music & Composer: Shubham Raj (SBR)
